title: Rename Scheduler.scheduleJob to submitJob
prompts: Rename the Scheduler method `scheduleJob` to `submitJob` everywhere: the code and its callers, the CLI help text, the docs and README, the tests, and the log and error messages that spell the old name. `rescheduleJob` is a different method: leave it alone. Keep the test suite green.
notes: 38 references over src, docs, README and tests; 9 of them are the decoy `rescheduleJob`. A blind find-and-replace of the substring breaks it. Grading replaces test/ with the renamed suite plus a scan that the old name is gone from src, docs and README.
